command:
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C
echo '---OS---'
if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then
  . /etc/os-release
  echo "$PRETTY_NAME"
else
  uname -srm
fi
echo '---UPTIME---'
uptime -p 2>/dev/null || uptime | awk '{print $3,$4}'
echo '---LOAD---'
cat /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}' || echo ''
echo '---MEM---'
free -m 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{printf "%d|%d|%.1f / %.1f GB (%.0f%%)", $3, $2, $3/1024, $2/1024, ($2>0 ? $3*100/$2 : 0)}'
echo ''
echo '---DISK---'
df -m / 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{printf "%d|%d|%.1f / %.1f GB (%s)", $3, $2, $3/1024, $2/1024, $5}'
echo ''
echo '---NET---'
awk 'NR>2 && $1 !~ /lo:/ {rx+=$2; tx+=$10} END {printf "RX: %.2f GB | TX: %.2f GB", rx/1024/1024/1024, tx/1024/1024/1024}' /proc/net/dev 2>/dev/null || echo ''
echo '---CPU---'
(read -r c u n s i io ir st g gn < /proc/stat 2>/dev/null && sleep 0.1 && read -r c2 u2 n2 s2 i2 io2 ir2 st2 g2 gn2 < /proc/stat 2>/dev/null && id=$(( (i2+io2) - (i+io) )) && tot=$(( (u2+n2+s2+i2+io2+ir2+st2) - (u+n+s+i+io+ir+st) )) && [ "$tot" -gt 0 ] && awk -v id="$id" -v tot="$tot" 'BEGIN {printf "%d", int((1 - id/tot)*100)}') || top -bn1 2>/dev/null | grep "Cpu(s)" | sed "s/.*, *\([0-9.]*\)%* id.*/\1/" | awk '{printf "%d", 100 - $1}' || echo '0'
echo ''
echo '---DOCKER---'
docker --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'Not installed'
description: Probe CPU, RAM, Disk, Net I/O, uptime and Docker engine presence

command:
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C
TMP_BENCH="/tmp/nijibench_test"
rm -f /tmp/nijibench_* 2>/dev/null
trap 'rm -f /tmp/nijibench_* 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM

echo '===CPU==='
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    openssl speed -seconds 2 sha256 2>&1 | tail -n 2
else
    START_NS=$(date +%s%N 2>/dev/null || date +%s000000000)
    dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=64 2>/dev/null | sha256sum
    END_NS=$(date +%s%N 2>/dev/null || date +%s000000000)
    echo "FALLBACK_TIME_NS: $((END_NS - START_NS))"
fi

echo '===DISK==='
(dd if=/dev/zero of="$TMP_BENCH" bs=64M count=4 oflag=direct 2>&1 || dd if=/dev/zero of="$TMP_BENCH" bs=64M count=4 conv=fdatasync 2>&1)
rm -f "$TMP_BENCH" /tmp/nijibench_* 2>/dev/null

echo '===PING==='
(ping -c 3 -W 2 1.1.1.1 2>&1 || ping -c 3 -W 2 8.8.8.8 2>&1 || echo 'rtt min/avg/max = 99.9/99.9/99.9 ms')

echo '===CLEANUP==='
rm -f /tmp/nijibench_* 2>/dev/null
echo 'OK'
description: Non-destructive hardware benchmark measuring disk write, CPU SHA256 throughput, and gateway latency with automatic cleanup
Inspect open listening TCP and UDP sockets with PID and process names

command:
NEW_PORT={newPort}

if ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$NEW_PORT\b"; then
  echo "PORT_IN_USE"
  exit 1
fi

cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.serverdeck.bak 2>/dev/null || true

if grep -q -E "^[#]*[[:space:]]*Port[[:space:]]+" /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  sed -i -E "s/^[#]*[[:space:]]*Port[[:space:]]+[0-9]+/Port $NEW_PORT/" /etc/ssh/sshd_config
else
  echo "Port $NEW_PORT" >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config
fi

if [ -d /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d ]; then
  echo "Port $NEW_PORT" > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-serverdeck-port.conf
fi

sshd -t 2>&1
TEST_EXIT=$?

if [ $TEST_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "SSHD_TEST_FAILED"
  if [ -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.serverdeck.bak ]; then
    cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config.serverdeck.bak /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  fi
  if [ -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-serverdeck-port.conf ]; then
    rm -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-serverdeck-port.conf
  fi
  exit 1
fi

if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 && ufw status 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Status: active"; then
  ufw allow $NEW_PORT/tcp 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if command -v iptables >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport $NEW_PORT -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport $NEW_PORT -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
fi

systemctl reload ssh 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart ssh 2>/dev/null || service ssh reload 2>/dev/null || service ssh restart 2>/dev/null || true

echo "SSHD_HARDENING_SUCCESS"
description: Harden SSH by testing and migrating daemon port to high ephemeral port

command:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '---PM:apt---'
  apt-get update -qq 2>&1 || true
  apt-get -s upgrade 2>&1
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '---PM:dnf---'
  dnf check-update 2>&1 || true
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '---PM:yum---'
  yum check-update 2>&1 || true
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '---PM:pacman---'
  pacman -Sy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  pacman -Qu 2>&1
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '---PM:apk---'
  apk update >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  apk version -v -l '<' 2>&1
else
  echo '---PM:unknown---'
fi
description: Check pending updates across apt, dnf, yum, pacman, or apk

command:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get upgrade -y
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf upgrade -y
elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  yum upgrade -y
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Syu --noconfirm
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk upgrade
else
  echo 'No supported package manager found (apt, dnf, yum, pacman, apk)' >&2
  exit 1
fi
description: Perform unattended OS package upgrade across apt, dnf, yum, pacman, or apk
Simulate APT package upgrade to check pending regular and security updates
Check pending DNF/RPM package updates on RedHat and Fedora systems
Perform unattended OS package upgrade via APT
